newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Wing Tiek can't finalise buyout terms.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tiek can't finalise buyout terms.

text.p: Malaysian industrial group Wing Tiek Holdings Bhd said on Thursday it was still unable to finalise the terms of a proposed management buyout.

"The company requires additional time to complete its negotiations and to finalise the terms so that it will be mutually beneficial and acceptable to all parties concerned," the company said in a statement issued by its merchant bankers.

Earlier this month, Wing Tiek said three of its directors, led by executive chairman Lew Sip Hon had signed a management buyout agreement with major shareholder Westmont Holdings Sdn Bhd for the voting rights on 30.23 percent of Wing Tiek's equity.
The purchase of Westmont Holdings equity would trigger a general offer for the rest of the Wing Tiek equity.
Wing Tiek requested the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to lift the voluntary suspension of its stock. The stock was last traded on May 13 at 4.92 ringgit.
